notes.title: UPDATE 1.08 New Features & Fixes
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/26u4lcahOKQcNr1Cg/giphy.gif


*IMPORTANT*

We highly recommend that you start a fresh run after update has been applied.



Additions: 


# Linux / SteamOS now supports the same lighting and soft shadows as Windows.

# Added 2 additional starting rooms on 1 - 1. 

# 1 - 1 now randomizes between 3 different world locations.

# HUD now display controller buttons for different actions (GP only)

# Updated the look of gamepad HUD button icons. 

# Minimap now displays a wider variety of rooms. 

# Score counter added to daily run. 

# Added indicator for when holo power is fully recharged. 

# Starting speed has been increased with ~ 10 %.



Bug fixes: 


# Crash on Continue (DO NOT use continue directly after applying update, start a new game.)

# Crash on Interact panel. 

# Stuck in Birthday cake after continue.

# Piglets could get stuck in table 

# The Traitor's plasma rifle can't harm vending machines.
 
# The Traitor's plasma rifle has no stopping power versus ghosts in Stage ?

# The Traitor's plasma rifle bullets don’t stop on impact with the Ghost boss books. 

# Inability to trigger c4 with Keyboard. 

# Rotating laser turrets keep shooting when pause menu is activated.

# Several changes to the Russian translation.

# Game could crash if player died in the same frame as a wasp. 

# Luck upgrade not displayed in inventory after unlock. 

# Could get stuck between train carts if playing with mouse / keyboard.



As always thank you for your support and help with reporting bugs.

notes.title: 1.07 GERMAN & RUSSIAN TRANSLATION UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://static1.squarespace.com/static/56feea2d86db43daa3e63059/t/5915d147725e25353cf32a20/1494602056089/pandakeeperflags.png?format=300w





Update 1.07 brings full support for Russian and German as an ingame language option. 
 
The store front page has been completely localized to both languages. 

We have also made some changes to the upgrade menu, allowing new players to buy certain upgrades like speed and keycards at a faster rate.  Making it a bit easier to progress through the dungeon when you are still new to the game. 

Additional dialog has been added to several merchants. 

We have done some additional tweaks to some Boss states in hard mode. 

Blue keycards are now guaranteed to drop on 1 – 1 the first three times you play the game.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 LIVE
notes.notes:
https://static1.squarespace.com/static/56feea2d86db43daa3e63059/t/58ad581a6b8f5bb8e6e92cc1/1487755294166/?format=100w


*IMPORTANT* 

We highly recommend that you start a fresh run after update has been applied. 


Patch notes 1.05

Bugs: 

- Map scroll now displays properly.

- Second chance helmet didn't work if killed while on fire. 

- Trading AttackbotA with AttackbotB left player with both bots. 

- Warp shift helmet misc issues fixed. 

- Frame drops could cause player to get stuck in doorways.

- Misc particle effects removed from Gameover Screen.

- Random crash when using flamethrower on small crates. 

- Random Crash when using warp gates on 1 -1 in normal / easy mode. 

- Random crash when leaving ??? with the book. 

- Clicking some lights could cause unwanted behavior. 


Changes: 


- Ball of Fire Scroll: Tweaked now creates a fire trace. 

- Flame thrower now lets you set fire to pretty much anything. 

- Mini pigs added to birthday party rooms. 

- Tweaked states for most regular bosses in Hard, Curse and Daily Mode, 
  exluding: The king, Jehogtsuo and the Corrupted. 
 

As always thank you for your support and help with reporting bugs. 

Note: MacOS is still on 1.04 patch will go live within the next 24 hours.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 LIVE!
notes.notes:
https://static1.squarespace.com/static/56feea2d86db43daa3e63059/t/58f2326ed1758ea2d481c6fe/1492267631381/warchief.gif?format=300w



*IMPORTANT* 

We highly recomend that you start a fresh run after update has been applied.

Patch Notes: 1.03

- Speech bubble duplicate in 4k resolution. 

- Force roll sound during car section. 

- Jehogtsuo (Boss stg 5) did in rare cases not die.

- Looping fire sound when dodging mage firecross. 

- Minimap connection visibility slightly increased.

- Could return back to the kings hall in curse mode. 

- Adrenaline pickup banner typo. 

- Bludclone crash. 

- Use button crash. 

- Holding down the Weapon Switch button caused animation glitch. 

- Possible fix for 4k displays on Linux staring in windowed mode. 

- The traitor character no longer shows as Panda Marine in first end scene. 

- Achievement (Fire) could be unlocked in normal mode. 

- Orbs are now persistent between rooms. 

- Vending machines can now be blown up by dynamite. 

- Idle NPC's Now react to dynamite. 

- Intro and stage clear can now be bypassed with any keyboard key. 

- Panda turns 180 degrees when opening chest (keyboard)


Huge thank you to all that have provided feedback and reported bugs.  Also if you haven’t already please consider leaving a review.

- Some balancing for daily runs.
